title: Lid-twist jar for the restock reel
said: the lid twists open with one hand and it clicks, that click is the whole thing, I want people to hear it
gist: A reel built around the one-handed lid twist and its click.
picture: amber glass jar on a kitchen counter, morning light

title: Rooftop chase at golden hour
said: start on the stairs, burst out onto the roof, the city behind, and the camera never stops moving
gist: One continuous run from the stairwell to the roof edge.
picture: rooftop at sunset, city skyline, lens flare

title: Why my candles cost what they cost
said: people ask why forty dollars, so walk through the wax, the wick, the eight hours, the jar
gist: A talking piece that breaks down what goes into one candle.
